literature.title: Ultra weak photon emission—a brief review
literature.bounded_read: UPE is described as an ultra-low-intensity metabolic photon-emission phenomenon, with ROS/oxidative processes as a major accepted mechanism; Parkinson disease is discussed as an oxidative-stress condition, but this source does not establish a Parkinson-specific endogenous UPE biomarker or nonclassical photon statistics.

literature.title: Human Ultraweak Photon Emission: Key Analytical Aspects, Results and Future Trends - A Review
literature.bounded_read: Human UPE measurement is methodologically feasible but depends on many internal/external factors; the review calls for larger populations, spectra plus intensity, and stronger statistical designs.

literature.title: Photoencephalography as a non-electrical modality for investigating brain function: methodological and ethical considerations
literature.bounded_read: The retrieved 2026 commentary cautions that brain-UPE evidence remains patchy, can be exaggerated, and has repeatability/methodology problems; it does not support premature neurodiagnostic promotion.

ngs_orthogonal_lane.purpose: Measure transcriptomic oxidative-stress / mitochondrial / inflammatory context in a declared Parkinson model or cohort without using RNA-seq as optical or quantum evidence.
ngs_orthogonal_lane.public_default: nf-core/rnaseq or plugin-owned bulk RNA-seq counts/QC -> differential-expression path after explicit sample/design inputs
ngs_orthogonal_lane.optional_gpu_acceleration: NVIDIA Parabricks pbrun rna_fq2bam may replace the STAR-alignment stage only after version, reference, STAR genome library, sample structure, GPU runtime, and output parity are bound.
